title: Vegan Kebab Delight
description: A flavorful and healthy vegan kebab dish, perfect for a quick and delicious meal.

ingredients.name: Lamb substitute (seitan)
ingredients.notes: marinated in a mix of olive oil, lemon juice, and herbs

instructions: Marinate the seitan in a mix of olive oil, lemon juice, and herbs for at least 30 minutes.
Grill the portobello mushrooms and seitan for 3-4 minutes per side.
Warm the pita bread by wrapping it in foil and heating it in the oven for 5 minutes.
Assemble the kebabs by placing the grilled mushrooms and seitan onto the pita bread.
Top the kebabs with a dollop of vegan tzatziki sauce, chopped cucumber, tomato, and parsley.
Drizzle with lemon juice and olive oil.
